28 Swiss Re Institute sigma No 1/2025  
Appendix: facts and figures
Total economic losses: USD 328 billion 
Economic losses were highest in North America, driven by Hurricane Helene 
(USD 79 billion), and severe convective storms. 
Global natural catastrophe protection gap: USD 181 billion
Figure 20 shows global economic and insured losses over time. This highlights the 
insurance protection gap, ie the financial loss generated by natural catastrophes not 
covered by insurance. In 2024, the global natural catastrophe protection gap was 
around USD 181 billion, up from 177 in 2023 and from the previous 10-year average 
of USD 143 billion.
